question: Who among the following table tennis players won nine Senior National Championships as of April 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __A Sharath Kamal__.

__
 
• Achanta Sharath Kamal was the first Indian table tennis player ever to become nine times senior national champion as of April 2021.
